title: Post
description: An office that exists independently of whoever holds it, e.g. 'Mayor of Example City' or 'Councilmember, District 2'.

@type.description: Always `Post`. A `Role` binds a person to a body for a span of time, but when nobody holds the office there is no `Role` - a `Post` is what a vacancy is a vacancy of, and what a succession runs through. Equivalent to Popolo `Post`; schema.org has no such concept, so `gs:Post` is minted as a subclass of `schema:Role`.

roleName.description: The office title as the body names it locally.

description.description: A plain-language description of the office's responsibilities.

identifier.description: Any scheme-qualified identifiers for this post beyond its `@id`.

memberOf.description: The `GovernmentOrganization` the office sits in. Required - an office with no body cannot be placed.

namedPosition.description: A named seat, e.g. 'Seat B'. Real schema.org `Role` property.

numberedPosition.description: A numbered seat. Real schema.org `Role` property.

representsJurisdiction.description: For seats tied to a ward or district rather than the whole area - a `Jurisdiction` of level submunicipal or subregional.

roleClassification.description: How the office is filled. termCode from the `RoleClassification` code list.

termDuration.description: Nominal length of one term, as an ISO 8601 duration, e.g. 'P4Y'. Nominal, not actual: a specific tenure's real dates live on the Role.

endDate.description: When the office was abolished. Present means it no longer exists.

vacantSince.description: Set when the office is currently unfilled. A vacancy is publishable information, not an absence of data - omitting it is indistinguishable from not having collected it.

sourceDataset.description: The `Dataset` this record was published as part of.
